steps.say: **+ New class** along the top of **My Classes** is where a class of your own starts. A class holds a roster, its own place on the course, and everything the class practises together.
It asks for two things: a name you will recognise on a list, such as Year 7 Welsh, and the language the class is learning.
The join link is made for you at the same moment as the class. Nothing else is needed to start teaching.
steps.terminal: That's making a class — a name, a language, and a link students join by. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
